06_After_Inter_Govt_Jobs/01_TG_Police_Co.title: Telangana Police Constable (Civil, AR, TGSP, Fireman, Jail Warder)

b.x: Age relaxation (Telangana): SC/ST/BC +5 yrs, PwBD +10 yrs, State Govt employees +5 yrs, Ex-servicemen +3 yrs (as per notification).
PET/PMT: running, long jump, shot put; height men ~167.6 cm, women ~152.5 cm.
Watch Employment News, Eenadu/Sakshi job pages and the official site for notifications.
Keep 10th memo, caste certificate, residence (local) certificate, Aadhaar and photos ready.
Daily: Maths/Reasoning 1 hr, GK & current affairs 30 min, English 30 min.
For physical tests start running practice at least 3 months early.
